task_grounding:
Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/empty.aup loaded. The project currently has zero audio tracks.

Create three new mono audio tracks and give each a specific name, in this exact top-to-bottom order:

1. Drums (top-most track)
2. Bass (middle)
3. Synth (bottom)

How to create each track:
- Use Tracks > Add New > Mono Track. A new empty mono wavetrack will appear at the bottom of the track list. Repeat three times so the project has three empty mono tracks.

How to rename each track:
- Click the small drop-down arrow on the track's control panel (next to the default track name 'Audio Track') and choose 'Name...', or double-click the track name label.
- Type the desired name and press Enter.
- Rename the first added track to 'Drums', the second to 'Bass', and the third to 'Synth'.

Once there are exactly three mono wavetracks named Drums/Bass/Synth in that order, save the project with Ctrl+S so the changes are persisted to /home/user/Music/empty.aup. Do not rename the project file, and do not add any label or time tracks.

verification.description: Track order is Drums, Bass, Synth top-to-bottom
